description: Completes classroom and on-the-job training to acquire, exercise, and maintain knowledge of the duties required to perform all inspection tasks ranging from First Article inspections to process inspections.
Reviewing written quality or inspection procedures for adequacy and evaluating the implementation and effectiveness of quality/inspection systems, including work plans.
Reviewing production activities and capabilities considering contract quality requirements.
Analyzing quality data to detect unsatisfactory trends or weaknesses in the quality/inspection system.
Reading, interpreting, and applying technical data such as blueprints, engineering drawings, product specifications, or technical manuals to ensure overall customer satisfaction is being adhered.
Performs acceptance inspection on all inbound aircraft to assess the total damage before beginning overall Reset.
Orders necessary components to complete Aircraft reset Prioritized workload and preliminary mechanical inspection of critical flight controls.
Qualified to perform various inspections on a periodic basis to include Phase, hydraulic, landing gear and flight control inspections.
Implements risk management techniques while performing quality maintenance and inspections on the F/A-18 aircraft.
Trains and supervises personnel at all experience and skill levels to ensure a cohesive working team.

On board the USS Nimitz CVN-68 Aircraft Carrier for a six-month deployment during Operation Iraqi Freedom. Collateral Duty Inspector inspecting 14-day, 28-day, daily, and turnaround inspections ensuring aircraft airworthiness prior to flight.

education.degree: U.S. Navy Aviation F/A-18 Hydraulic/Structural Repair School
U.S. Navy Aircraft Paint Touch Up and Markings

matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents a robust profile of an experienced Quality Control Inspector with extensive experience in military and civilian aerospace industries. Their expertise encompasses not only technical inspection duties but also training and supervising personnel, which highlights their leadership capabilities within the field. The candidate's ability to interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and technical manuals efficiently demonstrates strong analytical skills and a deep understanding of industry standards. Furthermore, their experience in managing risk during aircraft maintenance adds a valuable dimension to their professional portfolio.
